escalations_intro: How long something may sit unanswered before it goes past the person who ignored it. Level 1 is the first nudge; each level after it reaches further up.
escalation_level_hint: 1–5; two rules can't cover the same level for one event.
stop_on_acknowledge: Stop once somebody picks it up
no_rules_hint: Without one, an alert nobody reads is an alert nobody ever hears about again.
remove_rule_confirm: Remove this rule? Alerts already sent are unaffected.
unknown_role: That role is not available to your company.
factory_unavailable: That factory is not available to you.
level_already_covered: Level :level is already covered for this event. Two rules at one level would tell the same person twice about one silence.
role_not_person_hint: A rule names a role rather than a person, because one that names an individual stops working the week they are away — which is exactly the week somebody needs it.
acknowledge_hint: Acknowledging stops the escalation. Opening the list does not: reading is not the same as picking something up.
no_notifications_hint: Breakdowns, overdue maintenance and approvals arrive here.
in_app_always_on: Always on. The record of what happened is part of the audit trail, not a preference.
channels_hint: These decide how loudly you are told. Everything still appears in this list.
not_yet_delivered_hint: Email, SMS and WhatsApp delivery land with the messaging workstream. The preference is recorded now so nothing has to be reconfigured later.

MAINTENANCE_OVERDUE.title: Maintenance overdue: :asset
MAINTENANCE_OVERDUE.body: :plan was due on :due_at and is past its grace period.

BREAKDOWN_AWAITING_VERIFICATION.title: Ready to verify: :asset
BREAKDOWN_AWAITING_VERIFICATION.body: :number has been repaired and is waiting on your verification.

BREAKDOWN_AWAITING_APPROVAL.title: Ready for approval: :asset
BREAKDOWN_AWAITING_APPROVAL.body: :number has been verified and is waiting on your final approval.

FLOOR_REQUISITION_SHORTAGE.title: Shortage on :number

EARMARK_STOCK_ARRIVED.title: Stock arrived: :item

RETURNABLE_OVERDUE.title: Not returned: :item

EARMARK_WAITING.title: Still waiting: :item

FABRIC_INSPECTION_FAILED.title: Inspection failed: :number
FABRIC_INSPECTION_FAILED.body: The lot scored :percent points against a limit of :threshold. Open a wider inspection, or take it up with the supplier.

LOT_EXPIRING.title: Expiring: :item, lot :lot_no
LOT_EXPIRING.body: :quantity still in stock; the lot expires :expiry_date (:days days).

STOCK_COUNT_STALE.title: Count :count_no open :days days
STOCK_COUNT_STALE.body: :store — :uncounted shelf/shelves still not counted. The system figures on this sheet were frozen when it was opened.

WARRANTY_EXPIRY.title: Warranty ending: :asset
WARRANTY_EXPIRY.body: Cover from :vendor ends on :end_date, in :days days.

WEBHOOK_DISABLED.title: Webhook disabled: :url
WEBHOOK_DISABLED.body: It failed :count times in a row and has been switched off. Fix the receiver, then enable it again.

SUPPORT_ACCESS.title: Support access to your data

TICKET_RESOLVED.title: Ticket marked resolved: :subject
TICKET_RESOLVED.body: If this did not fix it, reply and it reopens automatically.
